conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: compute_dependence_matrix (Pearson, Spearman, Gerber with threshold 0.5) and compute_clusters_from_corr_matrix with Ward linkage, cut at three clusters or at cutoff_fraction from 0.05 to 1.0 under the three distance transforms.
conventions.evaluation: Partitions against the three true blocks; cluster counts by cut fraction; the Gerber matrix against a pair-by-pair count in the example script.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; residual volatility 0.02 per month.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 12 responses in three blocks of four, each block with its own factor (volatility 0.015), all loading 0.5 on a common factor (volatility 0.02); six joint shocks of 0.25 on the eight responses of blocks b and c.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: remove_first_principal_component and compute_clusters_from_corr_matrix with Ward linkage on 1 - rho, cut at three clusters.
conventions.evaluation: Eigenvalues before and after the removal; share of panels whose three clusters equal the three sectors; the residual matrix against the deflation formula in the example script.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; residual volatility 0.02 per month.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 12 responses in three sectors of four, each sector with its own factor (volatility 0.02); all responses load on a market factor with betas 0.4, 0.8, 1.2 and 1.6 inside each sector; market volatility 0.06 for the spectrum and 0 to 0.1 for the sweep, 50 panels per level.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: compute_rolling_smoothed_clusters with Ward linkage on 1 - rho cut at three clusters, monthly from month 36, under NONE, HOLD (recluster_freq QE), PARTITION_BONUS (delta 0.05 and 0.14) and SIMILARITY_EWMA (lambda 0.7).
conventions.evaluation: Cluster of a4 at each estimation date; switches of a4 and the lag of its final switch after the date of equal loadings, by co-membership rather than labels.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; residual volatility 0.02 per month.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 12 responses in three blocks of four (block volatility 0.03); response a4 moves linearly from block a to block b between months 60 and 180; ten panels for the means.
conventions.weighting: EWMA correlation with span 36 (cluster_correlation_span defaults to span); demean=True.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: compute_rolling_smoothed_clusters without smoothing (Ward on 1 - rho, three clusters), compute_cluster_stability_statistics, and score_with_stability_pooled_clusters with min_cluster_size 3 under NONE and ASSET_VARIANCE.
conventions.evaluation: Stability weights by response and date; mean absolute score change from pooling against mean weight; weights recomputed by counting peers in the example script.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; residual volatility 0.02 per month; the signal is the trailing 12-month return.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 12 responses in three blocks of four (block volatility 0.03) and two bridge responses loading half on two adjacent blocks.
conventions.weighting: Partitions from a 36-month EWMA correlation; stability weights with a 12-date EWMA and a 12-date warm-up.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO at reg_lambda=1e-6; CurrentFactorCovarData.get_y_covar; illustrative premia 5.0%, 1.0% and 1.5%, risk-free rate 3%, declared adjustments 2.0% (private equity) and 1.5% (hedge funds).
conventions.evaluation: CMA components per sleeve and variance shares per sleeve from the fitted loadings; the audit identity is checked in the example script.
conventions.returns: Decimal monthly returns; factor volatilities 16%, 5% and 7% a year, Equity-Credit correlation 0.6; moments annualised by 12.
conventions.sample: 120 synthetic month-end observations from 2016-01-31; eight asset-class sleeves on three factors (Equity, Rates, Credit) with stated loadings.
conventions.weighting: Uniform observation weights; sample factor covariance and residual variances.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO at reg_lambda=1e-5; CurrentFactorCovarData.get_y_covar with the orthogonal residual type; the sample covariance as the reference.
conventions.evaluation: Against the population covariance of the generating process: relative Frobenius error, and the volatility under the population covariance of the fully invested minimum-variance portfolio.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; covariances are annualised by a factor of 12 and volatilities are shown in percent per year.
conventions.sample: Synthetic month-end panels of 48, 72, 120 and 240 observations, 16 redrawn panels each; 40 responses; 4 factors with pairwise correlation 0.3.
conventions.weighting: Uniform observation weights (span=None); demean=True; population (ddof=0) moments.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO at reg_lambda=1e-5 on expanding windows ending at months 120 to 238; LassoModel.nowcast for the following month.
conventions.evaluation: Nowcast alpha and economic intercept against the next month's true alpha; root mean squared error by response group.
conventions.missing_data: Leading missing values for one response; five interior gaps for another; cutoffs with an incomplete final row are skipped because nowcast refuses them.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; residual volatility 0.02 per month; errors in basis points per month.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; six responses on three factors (volatility 0.04); true alphas 0.005 constant, 0 shifting to 0.01 at month 180, and 0; one response starts at month 60 and one misses five months.
conventions.weighting: Loadings with uniform weights (span=None); nowcast alpha with alpha_span 24.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: estimate_residual_correlation with frequency QE and periods_per_year 4 at estimation date 2026-02-28; CurrentFactorCovarData.get_residual_covar with ResidualType.EMPIRICAL and residual_corr_weight 0, 0.5 and 1.
conventions.evaluation: The residual block in correlation units and the residual volatility of an equal-weight portfolio of the first block at each retention.
conventions.missing_data: Complete panel; the incomplete first quarter of 2026 is excluded by the complete-period rule.
conventions.returns: Residual volatility 0.03 per month; residual variances assembled in annual units, 12 x 0.03^2.
conventions.sample: Monthly log-return residuals from 2016-01-31 to 2026-02-28 for eight responses in two blocks of four, correlated 0.5 within a block and 0 across; one response stored in percent.
conventions.weighting: Quarterly common grid; EWMA span 12.0 quarters converted from the monthly beta span 36.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO, CVXPY with CLARABEL, no sign constraints, zero prior.
conventions.evaluation: In-sample residuals. Held-out evaluation belongs to LassoModelDiagonalityCV.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and idiosyncratic volatility 0.02 per month; nothing is annualised.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 8 responses; 4 factors.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO at reg_lambda=1e-4, CVXPY with CLARABEL, with all four factors and with 'commodity' withheld.
conventions.evaluation: Per-month adjusted partition share of the in-sample residuals for the partition into the four carriers of the withheld factor and the other four, and for one shuffled partition of the same sizes (seed 20260922).
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and idiosyncratic volatility 0.02 per month.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 8 responses on 4 independent factors, of which 4 responses carry the factor that is withheld.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO at reg_lambda=2e-4 with auto_sign_constraints=True, gate tau=1.0, with and without auto_sign_adaptive_weights (gamma 1, floor 0.5); CVXPY with CLARABEL.
conventions.evaluation: Weights against 1/max(|slope|, floor)^gamma; fitted loadings against the true loadings by class.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and residual volatility 0.02 per month.
conventions.sample: 60 synthetic month-end observations from 2021-01-31; six responses, each with one loading of 1.0, one of 0.3 and four zeros on six independent factors.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: solve_group_lasso_cvx_problem with block_mode='cluster_factor', solve_cooperative_group_lasso_cvx_problem, and LassoModelType.FACTOR_CLUSTER_GROUP_LASSO with auto_sign_constraints=True and no gate, on the known clusters; 16 values of reg_lambda from 0.05 to 0.8; CVXPY with CLARABEL.
conventions.evaluation: Unit level sets of the two block penalties for two loadings; the rogue member's fitted loading along the penalty grid, checked against the orthonormal-design closed forms in the example script.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.

conventions.evaluation: Shrinkage of each loading below its own weighted least-squares loading, against the closed-form soft threshold.
conventions.missing_data: Responses are missing before their first observation; the validity mask removes the cells from the loss.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and residual volatility 0.02 per month.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LASSO, HIERARCHICAL_CLUSTER_GROUP_LASSO and FACTOR_CLUSTER_GROUP_LASSO at reg_lambda=1e-3, group_penalty='normalized', clusters discovered from the responses, no sign constraints.
conventions.evaluation: A loading counts as kept above 1e-3 in absolute value; false and missed are against the generating support.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and idiosyncratic volatility 0.025 per month.
conventions.sample: 48 synthetic month-end observations from 2022-01-31; 12 responses in 3 clusters of 4; 6 uncorrelated factors.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO under LassoModelCV and LassoModelDiagonalityCV with four expanding-window folds on 15 values of reg_lambda from 1e-6 to 10**-2.5; CVXPY with CLARABEL.
conventions.evaluation: Held-out R-squared and held-out residual sphericity per penalty, mean over folds, against the chi-square threshold at size 0.05; the penalty each selector takes; the missing-factor report of the omitted-factor panel.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and residual volatility 0.02 per month.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; four uncorrelated factors and 16 responses with one loading of 1.0 each and a second of 0.3 for every second response (24 non-zero loadings); a second panel adds an unobserved fifth factor with loading 0.8 on six responses.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example following the design of the sign-pooling paper; not market or paper-replication evidence.

conventions.evaluation: Share of active cells with the population sign; share of null cells given a nonzero sign; 2 Phi(-tau) as the per-response null reference.
conventions.returns: Unit-variance predictors; residual variance set per response for a population R-squared of 0.10; panels demeaned.
conventions.sample: 100 redrawn panels of 60 dates; 24 responses in 4 clusters of 6; 8 independent standard-normal predictors, 3 active per cluster with cluster-shared signs and magnitudes from [0.5, 1.5].

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.

conventions.evaluation: Fitted loadings against the true loadings (0.9, 0.45), the sign-constrained least-squares fits and the centres.

conventions.sample: 360 synthetic month-end observations from 1996-01-31; one inflation-linked response; Rates and Inflation factors with correlation -0.8 and equal volatility 0.02 per month; population R-squared 0.8.

conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.UNILASSO at reg_lambda=0.02 with unilasso_loo and unilasso_non_negative at their defaults, with unilasso_non_negative=False, and with unilasso_loo=False; 16 values of reg_lambda from 0.001 to 0.3; CVXPY with CLARABEL.
